## Checklist
- [ ] Skill baru memiliki `README.md` dan `<nama-skill>.md`
- [ ] Entri ditambahkan/diperbarui di `skills/manifest.json`
- [ ] `last_reviewed` diperbarui jika konten skill diubah
- [ ] `python3 scripts/generate-readme.py` dijalankan dan README dikomit
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate-skills.py` lolos (exit code 0)
- [ ] Workflow CI (Skills Validation) hijau
